# AGENTS.md — GitHub configuration

`.github/workflows` holds three workflows: [`gates.yml`](workflows/gates.yml), Delorun's own check gates; [`expected-filenames.yml`](workflows/expected-filenames.yml); and [`ci.yml`](workflows/ci.yml), whose jobs are `node-24` (static gates), `node-24-lint` and the verdict `all-checks-passed`. [The workflow list](../delorun/apps/tools/README.md#workflows) gives each workflow's triggers and what it needs. A workflow file added here must also be classified in [`workflows.ts`](../delorun/apps/tools/src/opening/workflows.ts), which fails until it is; a workflow that needs a secret, a self-hosted runner or a deployment is not added without the owner's say, and a pull request never enables a workflow or changes the repository's Actions settings.

In `ci.yml`, each job keeps upstream's runner expression as the branch for upstream's repository (`github.repository == 'deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness'`) and runs on `ubuntu-latest` in every other repository. Keep the job names `node 24 / static`, `node 24 / lint` and `all checks passed`, which a branch rule can require, and keep every blocking job in the `needs` list of `all-checks-passed`. [`scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts`](../scripts/ci-workflow.spec.ts) pins these settings.

[`issue-management/`](issue-management/README.md) holds upstream's issue-policy modules with their tests, which `gates:issue-management` runs; the workflows that called them are not in this repository. [`ISSUE_TEMPLATE/`](ISSUE_TEMPLATE) holds Delorun's issue forms, and `issue-management/policy.test.mjs` checks their fields and the [pull request template](pull_request_template.md) against the `dsh-pr-description` skill.
